name: OpenArt
desc: Image and video generation platform with character consistency across shots.
desc_zh: 图像与视频生成平台，角色在多个镜头间保持一致。
solves: Keeps the same character across a whole storyboard instead of resampling a different face each time.
solves_zh: 整个分镜保持同一个角色，不必每次重新随机换脸。
best_for: Reaching for it when you are producing a series of images that must read as the same world.
best_for_zh: 要产出一组读起来像同一个世界的系列图时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：AIwith.me tool directory recommendations; 2026 AI creative platform roundups。来源：https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/openart
